profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Cvent
profile.summary: Experienced Lead Developer with 20 years of experience in the web industry. Skilled in NodeJS, React, Javascript, TypeScript, Java, J2EE, EJB, Spring Boot, Python, C++, PHP, Relational Database, Document Database, AWS, CDN(Content Distribute Network), Jenkins, Chef, Docker and People Management. Strong information technology professional with a Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Mathematics from Hanyang University.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer IV
positions.description:
Working as a team to rebuild a secure service application using AWS from the legacy application which handles personal data. And modifying all clients applications to consume this service. They are built under different types of technologies such as ASP.net, C# Console application, Java SpringBoot and nodeJS.
- Implement Service Access Auditability
- Spring Bootify and move it to ECS
- Data Migration verifier
- Move Windows Console Applications to ECS as scheduled tasks
- Implement to expire data after certain period.
- Use many different types of AWS such as API Gateway, Lambda, IAM, ECS, ECR, CloudFormation, VPC, CodeCommit, CodePipeline, CodeBuild, Kinesis, EC2, AWS Auto Scaling, DynamoDB, Config, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store, SQS, SNS, CloudWatch, X-Ray, etc.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description: Same role as before but only employment type has been changed to Contract from full-time because of my move from Canada to United States.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
- Apply Microservice architecture to Product using NodeJS, Express, Sequelize, AWS Lambda, AWS Cloudformation, AWS API Gateway, AWS SQS(Simple Queue Service), AWS Cloudwatch and ElasticSearch
- Build Frontend Applications using NodeJS, Express, NextJS, React and Microservices
- Migrate Client Sites from legacy Product to new Product
- Design and Architect with DynamoDB
- Work with DevOps to implement CI(Continuous Integration System) using Jenkins, Vagrant, Chef, Docker, Bitbucket Pipeline
- Meet with Product Owner, Account Manager, Project Manager and Support Team to gather requirements, design products and outline schedules
- Manage three different types of teams( such as Maintenance development team, Project development team and Product development team) with 5-10 developers
- Develop development process and guide team to follow such as Effective Communication, Coding Standard, Code Review, Git Strategy and TDD(Test driven development)
- Train and guide team for their task
- Hire a new developer with Technical Director
- Lead Local Property Sites version 2(LPS2) project to design, build a product with legacy migration
- LPS2 was for more than 1500 hotels in 8 different brands globally using php, mysql with Content Distributed Network such as Rackspace and Akamai.

positions.title: Scrum Master / Developer Manager
positions.description:
- Propagated Scrum process to team and company
- Protected the team from outside interruptions and distractions
- Build and maintain several products and websites using php, html, javascript, sass
- Build Hotel booking path by integrating with 3rd party API (Sabre)

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Performed Website development for a client in hospitality field
- Built and maintained three products such as hotel product, restaurant product and campaign building product based on in-house content management application
- More than 1000 websites were built using each product
- Built and maintained several micro websites such as a restaurant site portal
- Php, Zend Framework, Mysql
- Integrated products with third party APIs
- Built several scripts for scheduled cron process

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
- Built Development process including delivery
- Lead to enhance and maintain product (UbiDesigner, UbiViewer and UbiServer)
- Coach team members
- Java, J2EE, Java Swing, Java Applet, JDBC, C++, C#, Javascript

positions.title: Senior Software Programmer
positions.description:
. Developed a deamon using Java which act as a report server
. Developed the report viewer using Javascript and AJAX

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
. Java and C++ Developer
. Developed the powerful chart component supporting more than 40 different kinds of charts
. Developed the report designer and report viewer using Java Swing library
. Developed the report viewer using C++ as a ActiveX Control
. Developed Java Servlet classes for the report server. 
. Designed and implemented Script Interpreter Engine.
. Developed the report viewer using C# and Adobe Flex
. Developed Windows Service using C# which act as a report server.
